subject: *: caller can use a fixed TS for fast reorg (#52993)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent with focus on DDL add-index fast reorg/global-sort TS plumbing and checkpoint persistence. The only plausible High/Blocker correctness risk I found (ResetEngineSkipAllocTS + attempting to update TS via EngineConfig/OpenedEngine without updating the local engine’s commit TS used during import) is addressed in later upstream/master history (adds an explicit local-backend TS setter before import), so there is no remaining High/Blocker issue attributable to this commit in upstream/master.
